headline: Board approved June 8, 2026 meeting minutes; no other votes taken.
summary: The Council on Aging Advisory Board reviewed staffing, grant funding, and the August 20th Bicentennial outing. Members discussed storage space, program funding, and committee reports but took no other formal votes besides approving prior minutes. The next meeting is set for September 14, 2026.

decision_evidence.quote: Approval of the June 8, 2026 minutes: First by Judy, second by Maxine, all others were in favor.
